# Orbit Documentation

> Orbit is a FiveM admin panel built with Better Auth and a modern React frontend.

## Overview

- [Introduction](https://your-domain.com/docs): Getting started with Orbit — features, architecture, and quick start
- [API Overview](https://your-domain.com/docs/api): REST API overview, base URL, authentication, and response format

## API Reference

- [Authentication](https://your-domain.com/docs/api/authentication): Session-based auth, API key auth, passkeys, OAuth, and error codes
- [Workspaces](https://your-domain.com/docs/api/workspaces): Create, read, update, and delete workspaces
- [API Keys](https://your-domain.com/docs/api/api-keys): Generate, list, and revoke API keys

## FiveM Script

- [FiveM Overview](https://your-domain.com/docs/fivem): What the FiveM resource does, requirements, and architecture
- [Installation](https://your-domain.com/docs/fivem/installation): Download, install, and verify the FiveM resource
- [Configuration](https://your-domain.com/docs/fivem/configuration): config.lua options, finding workspace ID, using ConVars
- [Commands](https://your-domain.com/docs/fivem/commands): Server commands, ace permissions, and custom events

## Self-hosting

- [Self-hosting Overview](https://your-domain.com/docs/self-hosting): Components, prerequisites, and quick start
- [Docker](https://your-domain.com/docs/self-hosting/docker): Full Docker Compose setup, migrations, and reverse proxy
- [Environment Variables](https://your-domain.com/docs/self-hosting/env-vars): Complete environment variable reference for all services
